aiSlang v0.4.0

The local + self-hosted `aislang` CLI: describe a multi-agent AI system — agents,
capability-selected models with fallback and spend caps, prompts, MCP tools, RAG
knowledge, evals, and how they compose — in one `.ais` file, then type-check it
and emit a running, observable, budget-enforced Docker Compose or Kubernetes stack.

Full quickstart: https://docs.aislang.org/quickstart.html

## Install

**Linux / macOS:**

```sh
curl -sSfL https://github.com/aiSlang/cli/releases/download/v0.4.0/install.sh | sh
```

**Windows (WSL2 required):**

```powershell
irm https://github.com/aiSlang/cli/releases/download/v0.4.0/install.ps1 | iex
```

Or download the matching tarball below, verify against `checksums.txt`, untar,
and place `aislang` on your PATH.
